смарт- is used mostly in compounds for smart devices (смарт-годинник) or as slang for a smartphone; clever = розумний.
сода = baking soda (the chemical); a fizzy drink is газована вода
Colloquial, often derogatory (за совєтів 'under the Soviets'); standard Ukrainian is рада (council) and радянський (Soviet).
спікер = speaker of parliament, spokesperson, speaker at an event; a loudspeaker is динамік/колонка
спектакль = a theater play/performance; an impressive sight is видовище
спирт = (ethyl) alcohol only; spirit (soul) = дух.
сквер = small public garden; square = площа (also квадрат).
стек = a stack in computing (or a riding crop); a pile is купа or стос
Historical term in English (ancient Greek stadium/footrace); the modern English word is 'stadium'
Ukrainian сталкер mainly = someone who explores abandoned or forbidden zones; English stalker = a person who harasses someone.
штамп = rubber stamp, imprint, also a cliché; a postage stamp is марка.
штат = state of a federation (US state) or staff; not 'condition' or 'country'.
Inflected form of статура = body build, physique (невеликої статури = of small stature); height = зріст, reputation = авторитет.
Ukrainian статут is the charter/bylaws of an organization; English statute is mainly a law passed by a parliament.
Only the British unit of weight (14 pounds, 6.35 kg); a stone (rock) = камінь.
суб'єкт = subject in law/philosophy/grammar (a person or entity that acts); a topic = тема, a school subject = предмет
сурогат = cheap substitute, ersatz (a thing); a surrogate mother = сурогатна мати
сеанс mainly = a session or a film showing; English séance = spiritualist meeting.
slang (Tab key, browser tab, guitar tabs); a browser tab is usually вкладка; a bar tab = рахунок
таро usually means tarot cards; the plant is also таро
тартар = tartare (raw meat/fish dish) or tartar sauce; English tartar alone usually means dental plaque.
техніка also = machinery, equipment, technology
Ukrainian тент = awning, canopy, tarpaulin cover; a camping tent = намет.
терор = political violence, terrorism; terror (great fear) = жах
In Ukrainian only a dated word for a will (usual: заповіт); the Old/New Testament = Старий/Новий Завіт
Only a statement or key point; a university thesis is дисертація or дипломна робота
торн is only the old letter Þ; a plant thorn is колючка or шип.
тікет = only an IT/support ticket (slang); a travel or admission ticket = квиток
титул = title of nobility or a championship title; the title of a book or film is назва.
modern English: title
English: only a band to stop bleeding; a turnstile is 'turnstile'
трен = only the train of a dress (rare; usually шлейф); a railway train = поїзд
English 'tramway' = the tram line/tracks; the vehicle is 'tram' (US 'streetcar').
Ukrainian трансформер = a transforming toy robot or convertible furniture; an electrical transformer is трансформатор.
Ukrainian тренч = trench coat; a trench (ditch) = траншея, окоп.
трибуна = rostrum, stands; English tribune is mainly a Roman official (трибун), the platform sense is rare.
тритон usually means a newt; shared only in physics (tritium nucleus) and mythology
Ukrainian траст only in the legal/financial sense (a trust, trust fund); trust as 'confidence' is довіра.
трест = a business trust/conglomerate (dated, Soviet era); trust (confidence) is довіра.
Ukrainian торф = peat; English turf is mainly grass with its roots (sod), though it means peat fuel in Irish English.
типографія = printing house (друкарня); typography = the art or style of type.
юніт = only a unit in computer games (slang); a unit of measure = одиниця, a military unit = підрозділ
a very common Ukrainian word, also = 'option, version'
Ukrainian віола = an old viol-type instrument; the modern viola is альт.
вагон = railway car (passenger or freight); English wagon is mostly a cart (railway freight wagon only in British use).
варант is only a financial/warehouse warrant (a security); an arrest or search warrant is ордер.
Gamer/IT slang; the everyday word for a wizard is чарівник.
юрт = historical nomad/Cossack territory; the tent is юрта.
English: a light breeze (poetic) or a soft fabric, not the sweet.
зеро = only the zero on a roulette wheel; the number zero = нуль
